Committec is horoby authorized to appoint and or-
ganize as many sub-conmittoos and promulgato such
rules and rogulations as may bo necossary to carry
out its work.
Te shall mect at such times and
places as may be designated by tho Chairman end
shall submit a roport on its activitios to tho
President of the Philippines from timo to timo.
All the funds rocoived by tho Anti-Smuggling Fund
Conmittee shall be depositod by tho Socrotary of
Finance with tho Philippine National Bank end with-
dravals therefrom shall bo made only by chocks duly
signod by the Treasurer of the Committoo and com-
tersigned by the Chairman and by the Secretery of
Financo, provided, that should the Chairmen be
concurrently the Socrotary of Financo, thon an
Auditor namod or designatod by the Fresidont of
the Philippinos shall. bo the other countorsigning
All books of accounts of the Anti-Smuggling
Fund Committoo shall always bo mado availablo for
audit by the anthorised reprosentative of the Au-
ditor Goneral.
Done in tha City of Manila, this 24th day of
February, in the yoar of Our Lord, nineteon hundred
and sixty-six.
(SGD.) FERDINAND D. MARCOS
President of the Philippinos
By the Prosidont:
(SGD.) RAPABL M. SALAS
Executive Secrotary
